goal: Decide whether to build an in-house notification system or buy a vendor solution

constraints.description: Must support SOC 2 compliance requirements out of the box or via configuration

options.label: Build In-House
options.description: Engineer a custom notification service on top of existing infra

options.label: Buy: Vendor A (Courier-style platform)
options.description: Full-featured notification orchestration platform, usage-based pricing

options.label: Buy: Vendor B (budget SaaS)
options.description: Lighter-weight notification API, flat monthly pricing, fewer channels

criteria.label: Time to Market
criteria.description: How quickly the option can be live in production

criteria.label: Total Cost of Ownership
criteria.description: Lower is better. Combined build/license cost plus 2-year maintenance projection

criteria.label: Flexibility
criteria.description: Ability to customize behavior, channels, and routing logic to exact product needs

criteria.label: Vendor Lock-In
criteria.description: Lower is better. Difficulty of migrating away from this option later

criteria.label: Maintenance Burden
criteria.description: Lower is better. Ongoing engineering time required to keep the option healthy
